selected_script.angle: Protecting robotic vacuums from getting stuck or jammed by curled rug corners
selected_script.hook: A robotic vacuum runs over a curled rug corner, dragging it and stopping with a loud error beep.

timeline.scene: A robotic vacuum cleaner drives over a curled corner of an area rug, sucking it in, dragging the rug out of place, and displaying a flashing red warning light.
A hand lifts the corner of the rug, showing a flat, matte black L-shaped sticker with clipped tips attached to the underside, and presses the rug flat back onto the oak floor.
The robotic vacuum smoothly rolls directly over the flat rug corner without lifting it or getting stuck.
A dining room rug corner stays perfectly flat and flush with the floor as heavy chairs are pulled out.
A bathroom rug remains securely in place when a person steps onto it after a shower.
On-screen text: 'Keep your rugs flat and vacuum-friendly. Get yours today.'

Do not include a CTA.
